title: Inzwi reKutenda Kwakavanzika
intro: Mukati medare rine hutsinye, uko kusatenda kwaive mutemo wenyika, mweya wega wakafamba netambo yakasimba yekutenda nekutya. Munhu uyu, ari pedyo nepakati pesimba, akateerera shoko remuporofita richishorwa nekutyisidzirwa. Nguva yechokwadi yakasvika, ichimanikidza munhu uyu kusarudza pakati pekuchengetedzeka chinyararire nekutaura chokwadi chine njodzi. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena kuti mutsigiri uyu ane ushingi ndiani?
clues: Ndaigara mumba memudzvinyiriri, ndichizvionera ndega kuzvikudza kwairamba zviratidzo zvaMwari.
Ndakachengeta kutenda kwangu kwakavanzika, pfuma yakavanzwa muimba yekunamata zvidhori.
Ndakanzwa mutungamiri wandaishandira achironga kuuraya mutumwa waAllah, murume ainzi Musa.
Ndakabvunza nezvepfungwa dzavo, ndichivayeuchidza nezveramangwana revanhu vaNuh, Ad, naThamud.
Ndakabvunza vanhu vangu mubvunzo wakakosha: 'Kana ari murevi wenhema, nhema dzake dziri paari; asi kana ari wechokwadi, zvimwe zvezvaanovimbisa zvichakushamisa.'
Nyaya yangu inotaurwa semuenzaniso wekutenda musurah inonzi 'Mukanganwiri,' pandakayambira vanhu vangu nezvezvirongwa zvevane simba.

outcome.label: Chii Chakaitika?
options: Allah akaponesa munhu uyu kubva muhurongwa hwavo hwakaipa
Munhu wacho akaendeswa kunyika iri kure
outcome.answer: Allah akaponesa munhu uyu kubva muhurongwa hwavo hwakaipa

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
